scope: Proposed receipt invariants only, not executable controller
CHECK: Validate exact target Editor/project/process/domain/run identity and approved file bytes before any ARM
Read unique observer slot and explicit phase state; reject foreign type/owner/key collision without clearing it
Return a typed user-result receipt; outer/inner eval success alone does not establish observer state
ARM: Within same AppDomain retain ORIGINAL System.Action Stop closure with exact registered delegate references in unique run-scoped slot, or forward to existing stable compiled owner
Do not reconstruct lambdas for later subtraction; reject key reuse and support owned partial-subscription cleanup
Write durable Armed receipt with owner/file hash, domain/process and bounded checkpoint scope; no after-reload promise unless separate bootstrap exists
DISARM: Retrieve original Action by exact owned key and invoke that existing object; do not recreate equivalent code delegates
Closure removes exact original subscriptions, clears only its own slot and writes Disarmed/closes writer exactly once
Require durable Disarmed receipt plus slot-clear confirmation; eval return null or transport success alone is insufficient
timeout: Classify as unknown operation outcome if execution could have started
Do not retry ARM blindly; reconcile owner slot/state/durable receipts only after same owned Editor is responsive
DISARM is itself main-thread work and cannot be assumed executable while a previous eval blocks the thread
reload: beforeAssemblyReload can invoke original Stop and persist a terminal pre-reload receipt
A real domain reload invalidates prior domain slot/static/delegate assumptions; no continuation credit from mere loss of connection or callback non-observation
Fresh-domain observation needs explicitly reviewed stable compiled InitializeOnLoad bootstrap/external receipt; not supplied by eval_file protocol itself
